## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 8 specifics

- **687 pages carry index entries**, 6,448 index headwords, 6,262 distinct. Located 92.1%, label +
  body 87.7%. No page is bound out of order and the misfiled-headword test finds nothing.
- **Against the typed witness** (`docs/witness-join.md`): it has 6,256 of the 6,262 distinct
  headwords (99.9%). Labels agree on 99.1% of the 5,655 rows where both have one; analyses are
  ≥ 0.8 similar in 90.4%, < 0.4 in 0.7%.
- **The ဍ section is the weakest** (pp. 804–818, located 76 of 130; the last hundred pages 85%). The
  bold ဍ of a headword is read as ဒ, often with debris (ဒ၃ယှမာန), while the same letter in running
  text is read right. Short headwords (ဍယှသိ, ဍယှာမိ) then fall below the fuzzy threshold. Not
  folded: ဍ→ဒ would merge two letters that both occur inside words.
- **Gutters cut inside the right column.** On p. 500 the gutter was taken at 0.554, inside the
  accepted 0.44–0.555, and the right column's headwords came out without their first letters
  ("က္ခိနီ (ထီ)", "ဇဓီတု ("). Over vols. 1–8, pages whose gutter is ≥ 0.54 read far fewer
  headwords in the column pass where they occur: vol. 2, 19 pages at 74.3% against 88.0%; vol. 6,
  25 at 78.5% against 87.7%; vol. 8, 10 at 68.6% against 87.6% (vol. 3's 24 are unaffected, 89.2%).
  See the brief, §22.
- **A label not in the map**: (ကာ၊ကမ္မ၊ကြို), twice; the witness prints (ကာ၊ကမ္မ၊ကြိ) 43 times.
  Left unnormalised until checked on the image.

## Spot checks against the page images

Three pages, every article compared with `08.pdf` at 72 dpi (25 September 2026).

| page | chosen because | index headwords | at the right entry | wrong entry | unlocated | labels |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 500 | an ordinary page (it turned out to be a gutter failure) | 12 | 5 | 1 | 6 | 3 right, 2 not read |
| 810 | the worst page (0 of 8 read) | 8 | 1 | 0 | 7 | 1 right |
| 413 | a bad page (1 of 8 read) | 8 | 7 | 0 | 1 | 6 right, 1 not read |

- **P. 500**: the left column's four entries are right. In the right column, cut at 0.554, six of
  seven heads were lost. ဇေဋ္ဌလက္ခဏ is placed inside its own entry, at its analysis; **ဇေဋ္ဌရာဇ is
  placed wrongly**, at the analysis "[ဇေဋ္ဌရာဇ + ဓီတု]" of ဇေဋ္ဌရာဇဓီတု¹, the next entry but one. This
  is the first wrong placement found in a spot check since vol. 2.
- **P. 810**: the ဍယှ… forms. Only ဍယှရေ (ကမ္မ၊ကြိ) is placed; the homonyms ဍယှာမိ¹ ² and the rest
  are unlocated, for the reason above.
- **P. 413**: ဇိဝှါ… printed with ှ, which the OCR drops (ဇိဝါ…). Seven of eight placed by fuzzy
  match, all right.
